method: `glyphsift corrupt --sites` lists every site the generator damaged. For the joiner_inject family at p=0.05 and seeds 1 to 3 on bench/corpus/clean.txt this counts the sites, and the sites that declare an expected rule (a joiner that lands in a Devanagari-based cluster, where the zwj_zwnj_misplaced rule is expected to fire; one that lands after a space or other non-Devanagari cluster declares none and costs nothing). The README quotes the totals: 599 of 807. The flagged_clusters column of docs/benchmarks/score-vs-noise.csv for the same rows (187, 205, 207) sums to the declared total.
